subject: Taxes
title: Will the IRS Survive?
description: A 60-second lesson on Will the IRS Survive?.

hook.text: Some politicians want to abolish the IRS entirely and replace income tax with a national sales tax.

buildup.text: The FairTax Act proposes a 23–30% national sales tax replacing all income, payroll, and estate taxes.

discovery.text: Economists warn that a national sales tax would be deeply regressive.

twist.text: Every country that's tried to abolish its tax agency has rebuilt one. Collection requires administration.

climax.text: The IRS will likely survive because its function is irreplaceable.

punchline.text: Abolish, rename, starve, or fund it. The tax collector always survives.

quiz.question: What happens when countries try to abolish their tax agencies?
options: They rebuild equivalent agencies because collection requires administration
